entries.case: prefixItems in allOf does not constrain items, valid case
entries.note: index 0 is constrained twice with DIFFERENT bounds (minimum 3 from the allOf prefixItems, minimum 5 from the sibling items). The tuple-intersection merge resolves a slot only when the sides agree or one is unknown, so a two-bound slot reports a conflict and the whole array projects never - an OVER-rejection, never a silent accept. Fix plan: docs/todos/tuple-merge-conflicting-slot-fold.md
